source.snippet: "it's crazy that this type of service exists (in a good way obviously). I just never thought you would pay for someone to do this" — comment in Ask HN thread about quitting six different illness-tracking systems.

problem_statement: People managing chronic illness or complex health conditions cycle through multiple tracking systems and tools without finding one that sticks, yet express surprise and willingness to pay for a managed/done-for-you health tracking service.
target_segment: Chronic illness patients and caregivers who have tried and abandoned multiple self-tracking tools and would pay for a concierge or managed-tracking service.
notes: Buyer signal: commenter explicitly notes surprise that people pay for this service — implies an existing market and validates willingness-to-pay. Thread context is 'I've quit six systems', indicating high churn and unmet need. Single data point but from a recent (2026-08-20) active thread.
